items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: He said, "He is the drummer that I hired. I told him that he had the job."

ctx.x: Was Freddie Fisher there at the hearing?

Freddie Fisher surprised everyone. Freddie Fisher came to the Union. He was not supposed to be there, because they didn't tell him to come. But he heard about it, and he walked in, and he told -- he told them. He said, "He is the drummer that I hired. I told him that he had the job." He said, Because he had done a picture with him, and when the regular drummer didn't show, he said, "Get Lee Young for me". He said, "I said to get him, he said, he came in and he cut it, they would say, you know, he cut the music…
